blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Seven plus nine equals nine plus seven. Which property does it show?
The same two numbers are on both sides. Only their order changed: the seven and the nine traded places.
Both sides equal sixteen. Changing the order is the commutative property.
So the answer is the commutative property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the associative property, because there are no parentheses being moved. It isn't the distributive property, because nothing multiplies a sum.
